text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A consultation... with me?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. More like, there’s something
I kinda want you to teach me...”
Today, I'm working hard on training alongside Katsuragi Ace... or at least, that was the plan—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu!! Lord Trainer!!
I look forward to working with you today as well!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: What are we startin' with today... sir!?
choice_data_list: Um, let's start with ten sprints...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
...Wait, I mean, consider it done, sire!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm off!!

Her attitude seems a bit off. That said,
it doesn't seem to affect her training, so...
I'll just wait and see how things go for now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
Trainer, what's my time!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Seriously!? Yeeaah...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...O-Oops, my bad! Forget I said that!
Umm..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……Aaaargh!
Sorry! Quick break!
I'll be right back!

—She definitely seems strange.
I want to hear the full story, so let's go after her.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—So teach me one more time, Yaeno!!
That "polite and courteous manners" stuff!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see, so you end up acting a bit too familiar no matter what. However...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Forcing yourself to keep your distance might actually come off as rude...
I believe building a friendly bond is important too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"No, but that whole approachable vibe is the problem!
I mean—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, alright, countin' on ya, Trainer!
Catch ya later!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ace, that was your Trainer just now... right?
You two were so close, it surprised me!
You're really on good terms, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
That's so awesome~ I'd be way too self-conscious.
Like, they're an adult, so I'd be overthinking whether I'm being rude or not.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Close?
Wait... Are we... too close...?
choice_data_list: So that's what was going on...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat?! Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: W-Were you listening...?

It seems she wanted to rethink her sense of distance and turned
to Yaeno Muteki, who is well-versed in proper etiquette, for help.
However...
choice_data_list: You didn't have to worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's true... I'm sure the two of you
have your own way of building a relationship.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There is no need for you to imitate my way of being.
choice_data_list: Yeah. We just need to be ourselves.
Yeah. It's fine for us to just be ourselves.

text_block_list.text:
To interact naturally, without stiffening up—
isn't that the way we ought to be?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I seeee~~, being natural is totally fine, then!!
What a relief~~!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Keeping your distance on purpose felt so cold,
and I was honestly feeling pretty lonely!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, but you're right.
It's fine as long as we're good friends! Yup!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! When our time improved earlier,
I really wanted to give you a fist bump.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's do it again, woo-hoo!
(Tap!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: And next, hit 'em with one more~!!

With the momentum of our fist bump,
she slung her arm around my shoulder.
Our distance closed drastically once again, but...
choice_data_list: Out of nowhere like that might be startling...!

text_block_list.text:
With the momentum of our fist bump,
she slung her arm around my shoulder.
Our distance closed drastically once again, but...
choice_data_list: Out of nowhere like that might be startling...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I know, right!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Proof of our trust! Two hearts beating as one!
That's how we gotta be, after all!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep being ourselves and take it easy
from here on out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Thanks for everything, Yaeno! The two of us are gonna keep teaming up as best pals!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Seeing you two so close is the best thing of all...!

For some reason, Yaeno Muteki was the one who got flustered.
...It seemed wise to be a bit more careful in public after all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You think so? My bad, my bad.
Guess we can just ease into it bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do one more fist bump!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: And then~ hold my right hand! Next, the left hand!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, clap both hands! Another clap!
And then—heave-hooo!

My body suddenly lifts into the air.
This time, I was scooped right up with effortless ease!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Trainer, you're not heavy at all!
Maybe I should make this my victory celebration!!
choice_data_list: Eep, I really don't think you should do that...?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, why're you saying such depressing stuff!
Come on, high five! Let's go!
